summary: Thin bar above the header with one short promise. At most one per page.
rules: Always write `view: desktopTouch` (`desktop` or `touch` only on purpose). The current schema defaults to it; older ones gave the label «Десктоп и телефон» as the default, which is not one of the values.
`appearance.background`/`appearance.color` are raw colours, not palette ids. Check 4.5:1 contrast.

Offer and condition come from the merchant and must agree with the delivery page and the subscription offer. A phone shows one line per module and cuts it at about 33 bold or 47 regular characters, title and body together: keep a module to 35 characters or less, the key number in the first 25.
A bar with `modules: []` renders nothing. Only the first 6 modules render.

One bar per store (stores keep one, copied from home): change the existing bar with `section set`, never `section add` a second. Stores that show the bar on every page carry it as one section copied to the pages, which `section add` cannot make; `page add` does not copy it either. A store without a bar gets it from the cabinet constructor.
A linked module needs both `link` and a real `linkId`.
Bar contacts are hidden on phones: contacts belong in the footer.

module_template.titleText: <fill: offer from the merchant, 20 characters or less>
module_template.bodyText: <fill: condition, 15 characters or less, or empty>

presets.name: dark-single-offer
presets.use: One commercial promise on a dark bar that fits one phone line. The default choice.
presets.evidence: one module in 15 of 21 stores with a live bar
fill: `modules`: exactly one module; `titleText` = the offer, `bodyText` = its condition, both from the merchant, 35 characters or less together.

presets.name: brand-tint-bar
presets.use: Brand accent or pastel bar (kids, beauty).
presets.evidence: brand or pastel bar background in 10 stores
fill: `appearance.background`: the brand accent or pastel hex from the store theme (`brandPrimary` or a palette background). Dark text needs a light background; check 4.5:1.
`modules`: one module with the merchant's offer.

presets.name: rotating-trust-messages
presets.use: 2-3 short service promises that rotate (delivery, returns, support).
fill: `modules`: 2-3 modules, `titleText` only (`bodyText` empty), each a promise the merchant confirmed, 30 characters or less, instead of one long line that a phone cuts.

presets.name: offer-plus-contact
presets.use: Service-heavy stores: one offer plus the phone from the cabinet. The phone shows on desktop only (phones hide bar contacts), so the footer must carry it too.
fill: The phone comes from the cabinet; if it is empty or all zeros, set `contacts.primary` to `none`.
`modules`: one module with the merchant's offer.
